doc.name: Dream Interpreter AI
doc.instructions: The dream dictionary of Dream Interpreter AI (dreaminterpreter.ai), in English: what dream symbols mean, and which symbols come up in real dreams people wrote on the site, counted by the dreamer's country. All of it is public and read-only, and no sign-in is needed. Symbols are single dictionary entries such as "snake", "teeth falling out" or "house"; a dream usually touches several, and each can be looked up on its own.

tools.name: lookup_dream_symbol
tools.title: Look up a dream symbol
tools.description: The dream dictionary's entry for one symbol: what it means in a dream, the countries where it's the standout or most common symbol in real dreams, a few shared dreams about it, and the link to its page. When there's no entry by that name, the closest symbol names are returned instead.

symbol.description: The symbol, as a word or short phrase in English: "snake", "teeth falling out", "ex". Singular works best.

tools.name: search_dream_symbols
tools.title: Search dream symbols
tools.description: Symbol names in the dream dictionary that contain a word, those starting with it first, up to 20. For finding the exact name to look up, or the symbols that share a word ("teeth" finds "teeth falling out" and others).

query.description: A word or part of a word, in English.

tools.name: dreams_by_country
tools.title: Dreams by country
tools.description: What people in a country dream about, from real dreams on Dream Interpreter AI: the country's standout symbol (much more common there than in the rest of the world) and its most common symbol, with how many dreams were counted. Without a country, every country with enough dreams.

country.description: A country's English name ("Brazil") or two-letter ISO code ("BR"). Leave it out for every country.

tools.name: common_dream_symbols
tools.title: Common dream symbols
tools.description: The symbols that come up most often in dreams written in English on Dream Interpreter AI, most common first, each with the start of its meaning and its page.
